# `adt lint`

Lint ABAP source locally via @abaplint/core

```bash
adt lint [options] [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description           | Default |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `[file]` | ABAP source file path |         |

**Options**

| Option              | Description                                | Default     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `--source <source>` | Inline ABAP source instead of file input   |             |
| `--json`            | Output as JSON                             |             |
| `--fix`             | Apply auto-fixes and print fixed source    |             |
| `--list-rules`      | List available abaplint rules              |             |
| `--preset <preset>` | Lint preset: btp\|onpremise                | `onpremise` |
| `--config <path>`   | Optional path to abaplint.json-like config |             |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
